scope: Interactive, live-validated mint form before normal wallet initialization; same transaction construction and wallet inventory; no deployment.

cause.mechanism: Initial wallet/application JavaScript delayed the first unit read. The early form now reads the unit, fees and schedule through a small transport; server-encoded read calls keep the ABI codec out of the early browser path.

conditions.cache: disabled; fresh browser context per sample

browser: Installed Google Chrome via Playwright; same public WalletConnect project configuration and local mainnet fork as baseline.

acceptance.definition: Visible mint form with all nine selectable tiers, enabled quantity input and enabled Connect control; actual selection, quoting and queued connection exercised separately. Full wallet initialization is measured separately.
acceptance.walletHandoff: 13 browser checks passed, including one early Connect click on mint/admin, tier/quantity preservation, unfinished text/focus preservation, normal connection, reload restoration, history, mobile navigation, context isolation, disconnect, and RPC failure/retry.

economics.verification: Independent minimal ABI unit/mintFee reads at the fork block and real UI input; zero submitted transactions. Early form cannot mint. Full mint still rereads live fees and rejects changed quotes.

preservedFailures: Initial early form probes and three-sample runs failed the bound at approximately 2.05 seconds. Their results remain in /tmp/shapes-mint-early-probe*, /tmp/shapes-mint-final-performance*, and /tmp/shapes-mint-acceptance-performance*.
An initial RPC-failure browser case exposed duplicate alert/Retry markup; fixed and final full browser run passed.

An initial pure RPC-list test invocation used the wrong working directory; corrected invocation passed.
Precomputed provenance artwork did not improve the measured critical path; that experiment and its generated assets/build changes were removed.
limits: The 2-second bound is established for the stated local production preview and throttle, not all devices or hosted network conditions.
The normal wallet stack finishes later (approximately 3.74 seconds under this throttle); a single early Connect click is queued and completes through the normal modal.

Physical browser extensions and cross-device WalletConnect sessions were not exercised; the standard inventory/config and reconnection path remain unchanged, and a real local Viem wallet was exercised.
No mainnet transaction, deployment, push or merge; no broad contract lifecycle suite for this frontend-only change.
Existing preview-wide lint violations remain; changed app files and new shared helper lint checks pass.
